newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Murdoch to meet Queensland state premier.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Murdoch to meet Queensland state premier.

text.p: The News Corp Ltd's chairman Rupert Murdoch will meet Rob Borbidge, premier of the Australian state of Queensland, at a private luncheon in Brisbane on Thursday, a spokesman for the premier said on Wednesday.
"Mr Murdoch and executives of the Courier Mail newspaper are having lunch with the premier tomorrow," the spokesman said.
The spokesman said the lunch would follow the arrival of Murdoch in Brisbane on Thursday for a meeting with his newspapers' executives.
The spokesman said the lunch was a private meeting and would not comment on the subject of any possible discussions.
The U.S.-based Murdoch is visiting Australia mainly to attend The News Corp's annual meeting in Adelaide next week.
